Which of the following options is/are correct SQL query/queries to retrieve the names of the students enrolled in course number (i.e., courseno) 1470?
choices:
SELECT S.name
FROM Students S
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Enrolled E
              WHERE E.courseno = 1470
                AND E.rollno = S.rollno);

SELECT S.name
FROM Students S
WHERE SIZEOF (SELECT * FROM Enrolled E
              WHERE E.courseno = 1470
                AND E.rollno = S.rollno) > 0;

FROM Students S
WHERE 0 < (SELECT COUNT(*)

A logical address is divided into a $b$-bit index to the outer page table, an offset within the page of the inner page table, and an offset within the desired page. Each entry of the inner page table uses eight bytes. All the pages in the system have the same size.

The value of $b$ is ________ . (Answer in integer)

question:
Consider the following algorithm `someAlgo` that takes an undirected graph $G$ as input.

$$\begin{aligned}
&\text{someAlgo}(G) \\
&\quad 1.\ \text{Let } v \text{ be any vertex in } G. \text{ Run BFS on } G \text{ starting at } v. \\
&\quad\quad\ \text{Let } u \text{ be a vertex in } G \text{ at maximum distance from } v \text{ as given by the BFS.} \\
&\quad 2.\ \text{Run BFS on } G \text{ again with } u \text{ as the starting vertex.} \\
&\quad\quad\ \text{Let } z \text{ be the vertex at maximum distance from } u \text{ as given by the BFS.} \\
&\quad 3.\ \text{Output the distance between } u \text{ and } z \text{ in } G.
\end{aligned}$$

The output of `someAlgo(T)` for the tree shown in the given figure is ________ . (Answer in integer)

question:
Let $\Sigma = \{1,2,3,4\}$. For $x \in \Sigma^*$, let $prod(x)$ be the product of symbols in $x$ modulo 7. We take $prod(\epsilon) = 1$, where $\epsilon$ is the null string.

For example, $prod(124) = (1 \times 2 \times 4) \bmod 7 = 1$.

Define $L = \{x \in \Sigma^* \mid prod(x) = 2\}$.

The number of states in a minimum state DFA for $L$ is ____________.

question:
An application executes $6.4 \times 10^8$ number of instructions in 6.3 seconds. There are four types of instructions, the details of which are given in the table. The duration of a clock cycle in nanoseconds is ____________. (rounded off to one decimal place)

| Instruction type | Clock cycles required per instruction (CPI) | Number of instructions executed |
| :--- | :---: | :---: |
| Branch | 2 | $2.25 \times 10^8$ |
| Load | 5 | $1.20 \times 10^8$ |
| Store | 4 | $1.65 \times 10^8$ |
| Arithmetic | 3 | $1.30 \times 10^8$ |

question:
A quadratic polynomial $(x - \alpha)(x - \beta)$ over complex numbers is said to be square invariant if $(x - \alpha)(x - \beta) = (x - \alpha^2)(x - \beta^2)$. Suppose from the set of all square invariant quadratic polynomials we choose one at random.

The probability that the roots of the chosen polynomial are equal is ________ .
(rounded off to one decimal place)

The expected length of the subinterval that contains $0.4$ is ____________. (rounded off to two decimal places)
